network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Database mode and multi-terminal server configuration.
network.mode_explainer: "Mode" switches where this PC's database lives (a local file, or a shared network server). "LAN Sync" is a different, simpler way to keep separate registers in sync over a direct cable — use one or the other, not both.
network.tooltip_db_mode: Switch between local SQLite and shared PostgreSQL.
network.hint_db_mode: Standalone stores data locally on this PC; Network connects to a shared PostgreSQL server.
network.mode_change_warning: Changing database mode requires application restart.
network.guide_db_mode_step1_detail: Ideal for a single register. All store data is kept safely in a local file on this PC.
network.guide_db_mode_step2_detail: Connects multiple registers to a central PostgreSQL database server on your network.
network.guide_db_mode_step3_detail: When setting up the server, use the Migration tab once to upload products and history.
network.guide_db_mode_note: Switching database modes requires saving settings and restarting CB POS.
network.tooltip_host: The IP address of the PC running the shared database server.
network.tooltip_dbname: The name of the database on the server to connect to.

network.sync_desc: Keep separate databases on each computer in sync automatically. Connect multiple registers over a LAN cable — one PC acts as the Main (hub), others connect as Terminals.

network.guide_terminal_mode_step1_detail: Configure one computer as the Main PC with a fixed local IP and Sync Port.
network.guide_terminal_mode_step2_detail: Set other computers as Terminals, entering the Main PC address and matching Shared Secret.
network.guide_terminal_mode_step3_detail: Sales and inventory sync automatically over your local network in real-time.
network.guide_terminal_mode_note: The Shared Secret password must match identically on all connected registers.
network.tooltip_terminal_id: A short name for this register, shown in sync logs on the Main PC.
